newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FCC adopts rule on Baby Bell affiliates.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FCC adopts rule on Baby Bell affiliates.

text.p: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it adopted a rule to implement provisions of the new telecommunications law aimed at ensuring a level playing field in the industry as regional Bell companies move to compete in the long-distance markets.
The rule requires regional Bell operating companies to set up separate affiliates to provide long-distance service in their local regions or to conduct new activities such as telephone manufacturing.
Bell companies would also be required to treat new entrants the same as Bell affiliates for using the company's switches and lines to homes, an FCC official said.
